Join UMOCA for Flow Share Yoga, a monthly series that brings together gentle movement, live improvised music, and close looking. Guided by Kellie St. Pierre with live sound by Nora Price, this all-levels, disability-friendly yoga session invites participants into an embodied experience of contemporary art. services.desc: Time, Truth, and Other Immeasurables opens Fri, Sep 11. Image: L, 03 49 09.7, +24 03 12, 2017. Airbrushed pigment on canvas. Collection of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints Church History Museum. UMOCA’s Fieldworks: Canyonlands invites a cohort of 20-25 regional artists to a 4-5 day creative retreat in rural southeast Utah, exploring human connection to landscape in the American West. Hosted in partnership with The Nature Conservancy’s Canyonlands Research Center (CRC), participants will engage with scientific research across multiple disciplines, join a regional arts dialogue about land in the West, and forge new connections that bridge artistic practice and place.
